description: This file defines the Maximum class, which provides static methods to calculate the maximum value among a set of input arguments, implementing Excel's MAX and MAXA functions as part of the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Maximum
classes.description: Provides methods to compute the maximum value from a set of arguments, supporting both numeric-only and inclusive of other data types, mimicking Excel's MAX and MAXA functions.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Calculates the maximum numeric value from the provided arguments, similar to Excel's MAX function.

methods.name: maxA
methods.description: Calculates the maximum value including numbers, text, and logical values, similar to Excel's MAXA function.

search-terms: Excel MAX and MAXA functions PHP
